name: codsworth
description: Plugin marketplace for Codsworth — the spec engine and the build engine for Claude Code.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Codebase-aware specification engine. Runs a grounded interview against your repo and writes a foundry-ready spec — locked, classified, and verifiable. Brownfield runs produce a flow delta against the existing system; greenfield runs produce an end-state spec; cosmetic runs skip flow mapping. Forge plans. Foundry builds.

plugins.name: foundry
plugins.description: Autonomous build-verify-fix loop. Decomposes a spec into castings, dispatches teammate prompts verbatim, runs parallel verification streams (TRACE, FLOW_TRACE, PROVE, RESEARCH_AUDIT, COVERAGE_DIFF, SIGHT, TEST), grinds defects to zero, then assays the result with fresh-eyes verification. Forge plans. Foundry builds.

plugins.name: adhoc
plugins.description: Stops Claude from racing on ad-hoc work. Always-on UserPromptSubmit hook injects a methodical pre-response checklist every turn — restate the task, mark assumptions VERIFIED-DIRECT/UNVERIFIED (subagent reports do NOT count as verification), cite CLAUDE.md and memory rules in play, surface alternatives, run a citation check, confirm before editing. Plus a Stop hook that mechanically blocks responses with file:line citations Claude did not Read in the same turn — catching the subagent-summary-laundered claims that preamble nudges miss. /adhoc:casual skips one turn, /adhoc:off silences the session, /adhoc:citations-on/off toggles the citation hook, /adhoc:deep runs a heavier analysis pass, and the second-opinion subagent provides independent fresh-context critique.
